```sql
WITH park_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM parks
  WHERE park_name ILIKE 'Garden City Park' AND addr_city ILIKE 'New York'
)
, clipped_raster AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, 1, park_geom.geom, TRUE) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  JOIN park_geom ON ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, park_geom.geom)
)
SELECT 
  MAX(rast_val) - MIN(rast_val) AS elevation_range
FROM (
  SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(clipped_rast, 1)).*
  FROM clipped_raster
) AS stats;
```
